name: BOXBOY!™
description:
BOXBOY!™ is a 2D puzzle-platformer available exclusively on Nintendo 3DS™.

The game features a minimalist style with black-and-white graphics. The gameplay revolves around the main character Qbby’s ability to create boxes he can use to protect himself, climb on to, or activate switches.
disclaimer:
You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
